title: Managed Backup: restore processing
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines restore processing.

## Tier basis

**Standard restore rate.** Standard restore processing; USD per GB.

**Rapid restore rate.** Rapid restore processing; USD per GB.

**Included completed standard restore count.** Included completed standard restores per holding per calendar month; integer.

| Contract tier | Standard restore rate | Rapid restore rate | Included completed standard restore count |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 0.017 | 0.033 | 2 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 0.017 | 0.033 | 3 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 0.017 | 0.033 | 4 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | 0.017 | 0.033 | 6 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | 0.017 | 0.033 | 8 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | 0.017 | 0.033 | 12 |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, included completed standard restore count is 2.

## Hypothetical comparison

For a hypothetical choice between the smallest and largest listed tiers, included completed standard restore count differs: 2 for the smallest and 12 for the largest.
